messages:
Sam W: Heads-up: proposing a new ingest + sampling plan for per-route TTFT and tokens/sec so we can build route-level SLO dashboards. This will touch runtime labels, ingest schema, and quota mapping. Start thread to align runtime / infra / console.

Maria G: Nice — can you post the proposed ingest schema and sampling knobs? I want to validate cardinality impact.

Sam W: putting a minimal example here (draft):
```json
{
  "ingest_version": "v2",
  "route_id": "route:chat/gpt-4o-8k",
  "model_family": "gpt-4o",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "p50_ms": 120,
  "p95_ms": 450,
  "p99_ms": 900,
  "ttft_ms": 80,
  "tokens_per_sec": 300,
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "rollout_id": "rlt-2026-03-a",
  "canary": true
}
```
(we'll compress/encode histos for efficiency)

Lee N: Cardinality warning: route+model+quant+region+rollout_id will blow up metrics cardinality if we emit all combos. We should define a small set of primary tag keys (route_id, model_family, region, rollout_id, canary) and keep quantization labels optional and low-card. Suggest default sample_rate per-cardinality tier: high-card routes sample lower.

Jon P: From the runtime side: adding route_id & rollout_id labels is straightforward. We also can emit a lightweight "kvcache_hit_ratio" tag. But we need a stable key for sampling so console's rollouts can correlate sampled metrics to sessions.

Console UX: For the UI we need stable route identifiers + rollout_id. Also a simple boolean `canary=true|false` filter is critical. If possible, include `traffic_tier` (prod/beta/dev) so dashboards can default to prod.

Sam W: Ack. Plan: add `rollout_id` and `canary` tags, normalize `route_id` (deterministic naming), and introduce tiered sample_rate defaults: `prod` routes default 0.01, `beta` 0.05, `dev` 0.2. Admins can override per-route.

Maria G: Important: sampling must NOT affect quota enforcement. Quotas need exact counters (non-sampled) or a separate non-sampled counter stream. Otherwise we risk under/over-enforcing.

SRE Oncall: Agreed. We'll need a fast-path for exact quota counters emitted at edge (aggregated counters) while sampled telemetry flows through the ingest pipeline. Also consider emitting compact histograms for p50/p95/p99 to keep cardinality low.

Lee N: Compact histos sounds good. We'll shard histograms to 10 internal buckets and encode them with base64. That keeps events small and limits ingest costs. Will add proto.

Sam W: Draft histogram proto snippet: 
```proto
message CompactHisto {
  repeated uint32 buckets = 1; // compressed counts
  uint32 scale = 2;
}
```
And sample-rate config example:
```yaml
sampling:
  default:
    prod: 0.01
    beta: 0.05
    dev: 0.2
  overrides:
    route:chat/gpt-4o-8k: 0.005
```

DeployBot: Created branch `ingestion/v2-metrics-sampling` and CI job `ingest-v2-smoke`.

Jon P: One more runtime ask: can we migrate `route_name` -> `route_id` (deterministic hash + namespace) so routing changes don't break dashboards? If we keep both, console will need mapping logic.

Console UX: Please migrate — but provide a 6-week compatibility mapping window where both are accepted. We'll wire the UI to prefer `route_id` but show `route_name` if available.

Sam W: Sounds good. I'll draft an RFC + migration plan. Action items: Sam draft RFC + migration plan; Lee produce cardinality impact calc and proto for compact histo; Jon implement runtime labels + sampler; Maria design quota exact-counter stream; Console UX prepare wireframes for rollout filters. Target: prototype in 3 sprints.

Maria G: Please include a reconciliation example in the RFC — how sampled metrics estimate true traffic vs exact quota counters.

Sam W: Quick inline example: if `sample_rate=0.01` and we observe `tokens_per_sec_sampled = 200` then estimated tokens/sec = `200 / 0.01 = 20,000`. BUT quota enforcement uses exact counter emitted on the non-sampled channel, so enforcement is authoritative. We'll include math and confidence intervals in the RFC.

InfraBot: FYI — adding `rollout_id` increases tag cardinality but is expected given rollout frequency. Recommend TTL for rollout tags in metrics (auto-expire after 90d).

SRE Oncall: Also add an alert for sudden spike in `tokens_per_sec` estimate vs quota counters (e.g., >3x) — could indicate sampling config mismatch or ingestion lag.

Sam W: Noted. I'll add alerts and a small playbook. Thanks everyone — will ping when RFC is up for review. @here if anyone else wants to be included, reply below.

Console UX: pinged design folks for wireframes.

Jon P: Adding runtime owners to the branch.

Lee N: I'll run a quick simulation to estimate prometheus/TSDB cardinality impact and post results in RFC.

Maria G: I'll review quota design once RFC is out.

Sam W: Closing for now — RFC ETA 2 days.
